		"jump" -> "fall" when velocityY > 0

		number timer = 0.0

		number startX = 0.0
		number endX = 400.0

	class Player can CanvasDraw
		public:
			number x = 400.0
			number y = 500.0

		constructor()

		functions:
			public:
				void onFrame(number dt)
					if gameOver
						return
					if moveLeft
						x = x - 240.0 * dt
					if moveRight
						x = x + 240.0 * dt
					if x < 20.0
						x = 20.0
					if x > 780.0
						x = 780.0

				void draw()
					canvas.triangle x1=x y1=y-20 x2=x-12 y2=y+16 x3=x+12 y3=y+16 color="#94a3b8"

	class Enemy can CanvasDraw
		private:
			number x = 400.0
			number y = 80.0
			number vx = 80.0
			boolean alive = true

		constructor()

		functions:
			public:
				void onFrame(number dt)
					if alive == false
						return
					x = x + vx * dt
					if x > 760.0
						vx = 0.0 - math.abs(vx)
					if x < 40.0
						vx = math.abs(vx)

				void draw()
					if alive
						canvas.sprite "enemy" x=x-14 y=y-14 state="enemyFly"

			number x = 0.0
			number y = 0.0

		constructor()

					if active == false

					else
